title: Portfolio proposal (DRAFT - built 25 Nov 2026, names not yet approved by both developers)
description: Output of the Portfolio Service (Python, Aykut). It stores the user's portfolio choices and computes the allocation deterministically (no LLM); the AI service only explains it. Optional fields added 25 Nov: basedOn.resultVersion, allocations[].label / oneTimeAmount, source, stale. Draft: field names may still change, with the approval of both developers.

basedOn.description: The IQ result the proposal was computed from. If the latest IQ is newer, the proposal is stale: say so instead of explaining old numbers.

resultVersion.description: Optional. IQ's resultVersion; a different value in /latest means the proposal is stale.

preferences.description: What the user chose after seeing the IQ.

option.description: INSTITUTION = 4.1 institution style, CUSTOM = 4.2 user-chosen focus, STANDARD = 4.3 balanced basket, AINVEST = 4.4 AInvest's backtest-based suggestion.

institutionStyle.description: Only for INSTITUTION: whose PUBLISHED allocation is used (YAPIKREDI = deposit based package, ISBANK = multi-asset fund basket, ZIRAAT = actively managed variable fund). The codes name the source, not a risk style: every institution publishes all three levels.

risk.description: The user picks the risk level, but only up to the IQ ceiling (segment LOW -> max LOW, MEDIUM -> max MEDIUM, HIGH -> max HIGH). Higher levels are locked in the apps and rejected (400) by the service, so chosen <= maxAllowed always.

investable.description: sharePercent = clamp(IQ - 30, 0, 70). Applied to the monthly surplus (income - expenses - installment) and to the cash above a 3-month emergency fund. Reserve (cash + 50% of the investments, as in the score) under 3 months -> 0, except when VERY_HIGH_INCOME or VERY_HIGH_WEALTH applied.

allocations.description: Computed in code; percent sums to 100; amount is the share of investable.monthlyAmount. The LLM must not change or invent any number. (Example: surplus 10,000 x 58% = 5,800 a month; cash above the 3-month fund 30,000 - 24,000 = 6,000 x 58% = 3,480 once.)

reasons.description: Codes that say why the allocation looks like this, RESERVE_FIRST, NO_MONTHLY_SURPLUS, DEBT_FIRST (a warning, not a lock), EXCLUDED_ASSET_REPLACED:BTC->SPX, FOCUS:BTC, RISK_CEILING_REACHED, PUBLISHED_ALLOCATION:ISBANK:2026-11. Unknown codes must be ignored. The coach turns them into sentences.

source.description: Optional, only INSTITUTION: where the published percentages come from.

stale.description: Optional. True when the IQ result was recalculated after this proposal.
